headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Stock Price Falls As Q3 Earnings Stir Valuation Doubts
headlines.summary: Netflix just reminded investors why expectations matter more than slogans. The streaming giant came into Q3 2026 with a reputation for relentless profit expansion and a trailing P/E around 18x that looked restrained against peers. Then the fresh report hit, the stock fell about 5% on the day, and the story turned to whether recent margin strength is already fully priced in. The headline is simple. Netflix delivered roughly US$12.9b in Q3 revenue and basic earnings per share of about US$0.

headlines.title: Netflix does everything but tell members prices are going up
headlines.summary: It has raised prices eight times since 2014, and it just told Wall Street what subscribers did after the last one.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
